crossRefs.note: Yahweh administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, Yahweh, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that…
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”
Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their…
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

translations.web: Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
translations.bsb: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
translations.kjv: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice
translations.asv: Judge me, O Jehovah my God, according to thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
